messages:
Alex G: quick q — if we go per-signal pipelines and add exporter affinity (agent vs gateway), what do we actually need to show in the console for ops + SRE?
Priya S: +1 this is the core ask from a few customers. minimal: which exporter a tenant's spans are routed to, retention per-pipeline, and current quotas/usage.
Mateo L: agree. Also we should surface routing policy precedence: e.g. tenant override > service.name route > fallback shared-exporter. otherwise people will be confused when rules don't apply.
Rui Z: routing precedence makes sense. question: do we keep exporters as per-pipeline static bindings or allow dynamic affinity (prefer gateway but fallback to hosted)? dynamic saves capacity but complicates billing and audits.
Alex G: dynamic affinity feels risky for compliance customers. maybe default to sticky affinity with an option to enable best-effort fallback in tenant config.
Priya S: UX implication: a tenant-level toggle in the console: `Exporter affinity: Sticky | Best-effort fallback`. Defaults to Sticky for enterprise tiers.
Mateo L: implementation note: collector config could include `exporter_affinity: sticky|best_effort` and routing keys: `route_by: [tenant_id, service.name]`. sample config:```yaml
pipelines:
  spans:
    receivers: [otlp]
    processors: [resource, batch]
    exporters: [redwood-gateway, redwood-archive]
routing:
  route_by: [tenant_id, service.name]
  exporter_affinity: sticky
```
Rui Z: thanks — that matches what I had in mind. retention also needs per-pipeline override: tenant can pick 7/30/90d or custom, then cost calc shows expected egress/storage.
Alex G: cost calc is important. console should show estimated monthly cost delta when changing retention or turning on best-effort fallback. small CTA: "Estimate cost impact".
Priya S: on quotas: we'd expose token/span-rate limits per-pipeline and global fallback limits. Also an alerting rule when pipeline exceeds 80% of quota for 5 mins.
Mateo L: on the backend, if we split too many pipelines per-tenant + per-signal we risk explosion of exporter instances. proposal: per-tenant logical pipelines, but share exporter pool with enforced affinity rules (sticky binding metadata) so we don't OOM.
Rui Z: slight ops wrinkle: debugging becomes harder if exporter is shared. need a mapping table and traceable headers: `x-rw-exporter-id` in debug mode. console should allow "show last N exported spans by exporter" for troubleshooting.
telemetry-bot: metric: pipeline_count_by_tenant{env=\"prod\"} increased by 18% after recent onboarding.
Alex G: ok action items: (1) Mateo prototype shared-exporter pool + sticky affinity (2) Rui add debug header & mapping table API (3) Priya wire up console mock for affinity toggle + cost estimator. target: spike before next planning (2w).
Priya S: +1. I'll add tasks to the board and tag the enterprise PM. :thumbsup:
Mateo L: will start a spike branch today and post logs in this thread.
Rui Z: I'll sketch the mapping API and sample telemetry headers.
Alex G: thanks folks — short sync Friday if needed. :v:
